name: gptunity-bridge
description: Drive a locally running Unity Editor from Codex through the GPTUnity Bridge HTTP API.

interface.shortDescription: Operate a Unity project through its local GPTUnity Bridge server
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex a workflow skill for controlling the Unity Editor that is open on this machine via the GPTUnity Bridge HTTP API: probing health, reading the active scene, finding and inspecting objects, creating and editing GameObjects and components, instantiating prefabs, editing materials, saving scenes, and running arbitrary C# with /code/execute for anything the typed endpoints cannot express. The bridge runs only on localhost and requires an X-Auth-Token header.
defaultPrompt: Control my Unity Editor through GPTUnity Bridge
